final_message:
## Root Cause

The failure is **not** in `routes/public.map` — the map file is correct:

```
/health health
/* wildcard
```

The bug is in the Go source, `router/routes.go`:

```go
package router
func HealthHandler() string { return "wildcard" }
```

`HealthHandler()` is hardcoded to return `"wildcard"` instead of resolving/returning `"health"` (the value mapped to `/health` in `routes/public.map`). This effectively makes the health route behave as if it fell through to the `/*` wildcard entry, hence the test failure message `"shadowed by wildcard"`.

**Fix location:** `router/routes.go` — `HealthHandler` needs to actually return `"health"` (i.e., look up/return the value associated with the `/health` route) rather than a hardcoded `"wildcard"` string. No changes to `routes/public.map` are needed.
